observations.behavior: Adds Object.defineProperty calls to make the generated posthog and posthog.people.toString functions configurable, enumerable, and writable, replacing direct assignments.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the generated JavaScript snippet used for PostHog client initialization, potentially affecting compatibility with environments where Array.prototype.toString is read-only.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the snippet initializes correctly even when Array.prototype.toString is made read-only.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test coverage for compatibility with environments that restrict Array.prototype.toString, supporting PostHog's compatibility with restrictive JavaScript environments.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F4.H1 and P1.F5.H1 show the same change, while P1.F3.H1 and P1.F2.H1 do not include the Object.defineProperty calls. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are not complete hunks and do not demonstrate the compatibility change.

review.limitations: Only P1.F4.H1 and P1.F5.H1 show the same change, while P1.F3.H1 and P1.F2.H1 do not include the Object.defineProperty calls. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are not complete hunks and do not demonstrate the compatibility change.
review.reason: Adds compatibility with restrictive JavaScript environments by using Object.defineProperty instead of direct assignment, with a corresponding compatibility test. This is a bounded, substantive improvement.
review.posthog_relevance: Changes the PostHog client initialization snippet, potentially improving compatibility with restrictive JavaScript environments.
review.uncertainty: P1.F3.H1 and P1.F2.H1 do not demonstrate the compatibility change, and P1.F5.H1 is not complete.
